notes.title: Major Update and Discount: The Story Deepens
notes.content:
[p]Ahoy, mateys! A mighty new update has washed ashore for [i]Pirates VR: Jolly Roger[/i] and it’s packed tighter than a sunken treasure chest! The game is now 40% OFF during the Steam Summer Sale![/p][p]
Here’s what’s new in this swashbucklin’ patch:
[/p][p][b]New Intro & Pirate’s Notes:[/b] The story now unfolds more clearly as you play, with a brand-new intro and scattered pirate notes that bring the legend to life.[/p][p][b]Now in Japanese![/b] A fresh localization for our crew sailing in from Japan.[/p][p][b]Parrot Options:[/b] Toggle the parrot’s jokes on or off. You can silence the squawks and wisecracks, but the helpful hints and guidance will still be there when ye need 'em.[/p][p][b]Parrot Fixes:[/b] That feathery menace got some polish (and maybe a cracker or two).[/p][p][b]Improved Swimming:[/b] Swim naturally by moving your arms down alternately, or stick to thumbsticks, your choice![/p][p][b]Smarter AI:[/b] Enemies are sharper than a cutlass. Keep yer wits about ye.[/p][p][b]Better Pickups & Inventory:[/b] Grabbing loot feels smoother and more reliable.[/p][p][b]Optimizations & Fixes:[/b] Less bugs, more booty.[/p][p][b]Haptics for Quest (via PC)[/b]: Playing on PC with a Quest headset? Enjoy newly added haptics for even deeper immersion.
[/p][p]This update makes the adventure more immersive than ever, whether you're solving the mystery of Davy Jones or just trying to silence that cheeky parrot.
[/p][p]Raise anchor, adventurer! [i]Pirates VR: Jolly Roger[/i] awaits![/p]

notes.title: 🏴‍☠️ A Pirate’s Adventure Awaits
notes.content:
Ahoy, mateys! If ye be looking for the perfect way to spend Valentine’s Day, why not trade roses for riches and romance for adventure? Pirates VR: Jolly Roger is on sale for a limited time—20% off!
Stranded on a mysterious Caribbean island, ye’ll embark on a treasure hunt like no other, battling cursed skeletons, solving ancient puzzles, and uncovering secrets long lost to the waves. But fear not—ye won’t be alone! Your cheeky parrot companion is ready to offer helpful (and sometimes not-so-helpful) advice along the way.

[b]Why Set Foot on This Pirate’s Paradise?[/b]
[list][*] 🪙 [b]A Treasure Hunt Like No Other[/b] – Explore a vast island teeming with mystery, danger, and hidden riches. Every step brings new secrets to uncover.
[*] ⚔️ [b]Swashbuckling Combat[/b] – Duel cursed skeleton pirates and wild beasts with cutlasses, flintlock pistols, and magical relics.
[*] 🧩 [b]Clever Puzzles & Tricky Traps[/b] – Outsmart ancient mechanisms and solve riddles to unlock hidden treasures.
[*] 🐦 [b]Feathered First Mate[/b] – Your parrot is here to help... or at least entertain ye with its cheeky remarks!
[*] 🏝️ [b]The Caribbean Brought to Life[/b] – Stunning, hand-crafted environments built with Unreal Engine immerse ye in a world of sunlit beaches, dark caves, and forgotten ruins.
[*] 🪝 [b]Immersive VR Gameplay[/b] – Climb cliffs, rappel down ruins, swim through underwater caverns, and swing across chasms like a true pirate![/list]Don’t miss yer chance to dive into the adventure at a discount! This offer be available for a limited time—grab Pirates VR: Jolly Roger now and set forth on a legendary quest!

[b]Get it now -20% off for a limited time![/b]

notes.title: Save System Update!
notes.content:
[b]Save System Update is Live! 🏴‍☠️ 💰[/b]

Ahoy, adventurers! 

We’ve been listening to your feedback, and we’re excited to bring you a major update to Pirates VR Jolly Roger! This update focuses on making your pirate journey smoother and more rewarding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/d6a00d821ed6f90b2fdda63bb38350274e8751d7.png[/img]

[b]What’s New?[/b]

[list]
[*] New Save System – Your hard-earned coins and treasures are now secured with a revamped save system, ensuring seamless progress.

notes.title: Thank You for an Amazing Launch Week! ⚓️🌊
notes.content:
[b]Ahoy, adventurers! ✨[/b]
It’s been an amazing first week since the launch of Pirates VR Jolly Roger! We are thrilled to share that the game managed to sneak into the top 3 at launch on Steam! This milestone wouldn’t have been possible without your incredible support. 📢

[b]Community Love[/b]
We’re deeply grateful to everyone who has jumped into the adventure, explored the island and uncovered the mysteries. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we’re excited to see that 83% of you have left positive reviews so far. Thank you for sharing your thoughts and helping spread the word! ❤️

If you’ve enjoyed your journey through Pirates VR Jolly Roger, please consider leaving a review on Steam. Your reviews not only mean the world to us but also help new players discover the game and join the adventure! 🌟

[b]What’s Next?[/b]
Our crew is hard at work bringing exciting updates soon to make your pirate journey even better! Here’s a sneak peek at what’s coming:
New Save System: Secure your hard-earned coins and treasures with a revamped save system for smoother progress.
Optimization Improvements: We’re working hard to make the game run smoother and more efficiently, ensuring a better experience for everyone.
Bug Fixes: Addressing community-reported issues to improve balance and overall enjoyment.

Stay tuned for more details—we’re committed to making Pirates VR Jolly Roger an unforgettable adventure for all! 🌴
Thank you for embarking on this journey with us.

[i]— The Pirates VR Jolly Roger Team ⛵️📦[/i]

notes.title: 10 days to go until release 👀
notes.content:
Yo ho ho! Pirates,
Happy New Year! 
In the new year we wish you only victories, both in games and personal successes :)

How are you feeling? 
I hope you kept your balance like this pirate ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/f0ef33e25c095e63dcfb65b1c11ea36cfa3a4db3.gif[/img]

and it's really important to resist at times like this. balance is a precarious thing.)
You can use the lying palm trees as a bridge to get to the other side. Why not? You are a pirate, you make the rules on this island. By the way, such a walk can pay off well. After all, pirates love gold. Don't they?

So, we're getting closer and closer to the release date for Pirates VR

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/c83892131cfa07f085f1b154dbed7baa469e9269.jpg[/img]

It was literally left to him to reach:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/f554adbfb55b986e3ecf3d83dba9037431e2fdef.gif[/img]

We get words of encouragement and we know you are there for us. For which we would like to thank you once again. We really appreciate it!

This is the finish line. But we're ready for it :)
Our development team, though, seems to have only quickened its pace. They don't seem to have any plans to stop. Our developers are also players who are trying their best for the players :) so, in this business they know no rest. they try for you, so the testing continues.... :)

We'll have to wait. Let's wait together

Best Wishes,
Split Light Studio

notes.title: 3 weeks to go until release 👀
notes.content:
Yoo-hoo-hoo-hoo! Pirates,

Pirates VR: Jolly Roger will let you experience summer swimming for as long as you want. Even in the winter.  After all, as you may recall the release will take place in mid-winter (14.01.2025)
Just take a look at this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/5a65316fb90d2cc4c4db33524ebf74b482b5d3e1.gif[/img]

Swimming is probably one of the most enjoyable activities (for me personally). 
Even though you can find treasures and other items at the bottom, it's also just plain fun :)
but please don't forget the safety precautions and don't stay without air for too long, after all even pirates need to breathe :)

It's a little exciting to write about, but we're only 3 weeks away from release:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/4005e7b45fbf095fb14b8f0599a64b317a023f56.jpg[/img]

Despite the natural slight excitement, we are faithfully moving toward the goal. 
There is a clear plan, there are actions. the team is working hard, now the finish line is open for them.

Pre-release preparation is moving along and there are some changes within it:
- Testing of the finished build is being finalized, 
- optimization work is being completed,
- some adjustments have been made to the Steam game page:
New header: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/f79693fc23906a603ecf5df7c2c915a02c9d87db.jpg[/img]

New screenshots and here are a few of them:

and, uh, our team has something else in store for you... but all in good time. See ya!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1443620/Pirates_VR_Jolly_Roger/

Best Wishes,
Split Light Studio

notes.title: 5 weeks to go until release 👀
notes.content:
Yoo-hoo-hoo-hoo! Pirates,
It's Saturday. Which means it's finally time for us to meet you :)

We're getting closer and closer to the release, which is on 01/14/2025 

We are getting closer to our goal with every step:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/e19d686b4d4ac38d19c1905cc888a21f2874f9ab.gif[/img]

Right now you can see a pirate climbing to the top of the cliff :)
It's not only fun, but also dangerous.
In our previous videos you may have noticed that bricks on the cliffs can collapse (whoa). It's quite painful and unexpected.
But, this time none of the pirates got hurt while filming :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/a9134f550ab9b024b77abbdaf896acaac5449ff7.png[/img]

Split Light Studio and VRkiwi team still have to solve some license issues, age restrictions in some countries. However, they solve it promptly (not always depends on us).
In addition, the developers are actively testing the current (final) build of the game for even small bugs.
In addition, they are actively working on optimizations

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/8c2e8223ef1e2273807a6c12f7752c278fe9b8f7.png[/img]

With only 5 weeks to go until release, time is flying by. But, we're almost ready for it (goosebumps...).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/805c8ca330ffab285dc0a49ec1e9769443fecc09.jpg[/img]

Once again we would like to thank you for the support you provide. It is valuable! We feel it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1443620/Pirates_VR_Jolly_Roger/

Best Wishes,
Split Light Studio

notes.title: Feel that summer pirate vibe, because tomorrow is December 1 ❄️
notes.content:
Yoo-hoo-hoo-hoo! Pirates,

Feel that summer pirate vibe, because tomorrow is December 1

notes.title: In this darkness, we need more light... 🕯️
notes.content:
Yoo-hoo-hoo-hoo! Pirates,
The veil opens, we are immersed...

Today is a special day for us, but it's just the beginning of a huge event.

So, on November 21, we announced the future release date - it will take place on 14.01.2025 (please plan ahead for this day)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/27e4c8533367260d8fd025f5b02daa0a1ee9d249.png[/img]

It's been a long road and more than one year of development, and here we are on the verge of the release of Pirates VR: Jolly Roger.
Less than 2 months to go, but we felt it was right to tell you about it right now, given your sincere interest the day before ;) I think you felt it!
The 7 weeks will pass very soon, but Steam will send you a reminder as soon as the game is available for download if you click on “add wishlist”. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/9b941b14ff70d307ba66480e5e090a90e2030fe5.jpg[/img]

The Split Light Studio team would like to thank you for your interest and support, it's appreciated!

In this darkness, we need more light...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/9fb3ac289207107c2438e9989f0f6d6d1f9bc794.gif[/img]

Now you can see some new mechanics that you can use in the game.
the lamp! it illuminates dark places well and sometimes it seems as if you can't do without it at all....
In addition, you may see another clue in the form of a scroll of information.
we just really want you to succeed :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/e0df0244bbaa104f6df08a68571368677fcc9315.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/4058c557266aeb969b5152b919f78d7f17cd316c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/766d4b36c06a17a0271bd741007ce8d83ef47580.png[/img]

Also, one of the most frequent questions: about the possibility of Pirates VR: Jolly Roger being released on PlayStation VR 2.
Yes, indeed it will happen. Tentatively planned for Q2 2025, but we'll find out a more precise date a little later :)

Looking forward to seeing you again next week!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1443620/Pirates_VR_Jolly_Roger/

Best Wishes,
Split Light Studio

notes.title: No, did you hear that?! 🦜
notes.content:
Yoo-hoo-hoo-hoo! Pirates,
I hope you're feeling great today

Sometimes situations arise where you need to try again. But, sometimes you need to rethink your approach and try to find a solution in a different way. Perhaps this is the case?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/26ee32663d693e9bad376354725b797849ef695f.gif[/img]

Sometimes you may hear barbed phrases or even outright ridicule from this feathered...
He's always there, wherever you are. However, don't be angry with him :) 
In fact, he often shows you the way. He is your coordinator and your compass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/af061555e5080ffde8b1ac15c1ce7a5a99d6a5ef.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/c6cfa1d687edfd379b495d52281718d73e144e1b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/e22d0bbc92070f9e2db9ed7a145807a47409feb1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/581e3ee1921ef5a6d8d851947e8a718dddc8479f.png[/img]

so our developers have made significant progress and some important tasks have been successfully completed:
+ most of the small bugs have been fixed
+ corrections and improvement of level design
+ optimization
+ some game mechanics
+ the final scene has been completed
+ subtitles + voice acting

As you can see, we are far advanced, but right now our development team is working on:
- active testing phase of the current version of the game, 
- improving game components, 
- compatibility with popular models of VR headsets, so that they work correctly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/528c0e234b4f349885b77b198c4a6a74ba417978.jpg[/img]

thanks for taking a few minutes today :) it's a pleasure for us. and thanks again for your reactions and attention!

See you all again. In a week :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1443620/Pirates_VR_Jolly_Roger/

Best Wishes,
Split Light Studio

notes.title: Treasure? The best thing that can happen to a pirate 💰
notes.content:
Yoo-hoo-hoo-hoo! Pirates,

[b]Yoo-hoo-hoo-hoo! Pirates,[/b]

It's been a week since we last met and it's good to be in touch with you again.

it's been a rough week, but it's been productive

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/5d85bd6dbfadf29e1f17077de17f63e242b50e0b.gif[/img]

As you may recall, on “The Island” you are accompanied by a parrot. He's a very bad spy, a very bad spy. But, his job is to coordinate you, to guide you to the next point. This is your guide. Your flying map. However, you can try to capture him. Will it work?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/e14e90c171187b7e235f6ce7e7a3586991de0bec.png[/img]

Shall we get to the news?

First of all, I would like to share some important news with you. Pirates VR: Jolly Roger now has a publisher, and it is VRKiwi.
We wish each other success and hope that this cooperation will be as fruitful as possible ;)

This is not the parrot from our game, however this bird is good too ;) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/0bd3c1a93a813b252906c1d0f53859c172f30a9e.png[/img]

Speaking about what the team is working on now, they have not only succeeded in their goals, but also significantly expanded the scope of work:

- Improvements and refinement of core gameplay mechanics.
- Integration and refinement of voice acting and subtitle system.
- Work on the final scene, as well as animations.
- Refinement and improvement of levels.
- Active testing of game builds and bug fixes based on the results.

Impressive. However, it's a work in progress
